title: Land at Narita / Haneda — 7:30pm
notes: Pick up SIM/pocket wifi and Suica/Pasmo IC card at the airport.

title: Tokyo Airbnb check-in
notes: Drop bags. Aim to be out and exploring within an hour of landing.

title: Shibuya / Shinjuku — first night out
notes: Dinner + Golden Gai bar crawl. Easy pace — first night, fight jet lag with neon and ramen.

title: Senso-ji + Nakamise-dori (morning)
notes: Walk Nakamise-dori shopping street up to the temple. Snack stops along the way.

title: Ueno Park (afternoon)
notes: Gardens, shrines, museums. Tokyo National Museum if it's raining.

title: TeamLab Planets (evening)
notes: BOOK TICKETS IN ADVANCE — sells out. Barefoot immersive art, ~1.5 hrs inside.

title: Mount Takao — Trail 6 day hike
notes: <1 hr by train from central Tokyo. Trail 6 = stream crossings + forest canopy. ~3 hrs round trip. Mt. Fuji from the summit on clear days. Back in the city by afternoon.

title: Highway bus Shinjuku → Kawaguchiko
notes: ~2 hrs, ~$27 round trip. Book ahead. Pickup at Shinjuku Expressway Bus Terminal (Busta Shinjuku).

title: Lake Kawaguchi — bike + Kachi Kachi Ropeway
notes: Bike the lakeshore. Take the Kachi Kachi (Mt. Fuji Panoramic) Ropeway up for the panoramic Fuji view.

title: Camp Night 1 — Retreat Camp Mahoroba
notes: Wake up to Mt. Fuji sunrise. Have Hinata Rental deliver gear to the campsite, or use Soranoshita.

title: Return gear → bus to Tokyo → Shinkansen to Kyoto
notes: Pack up camp, return rental gear. Bus back to Shinjuku, grab luggage from Tokyo Airbnb, Shinkansen to Kyoto (~2.5 hrs, ~$130).

title: Kinkaku-ji (Golden Pavilion)
notes: ¥500 entry. Quick visit (~45 min). Goes well as an afternoon stop on a travel day.

title: Gion District — evening stroll
notes: Lantern-lit alleys, traditional wooden machiya. Best after dark.

title: Philosopher's Path
notes: Quiet canal-side walk. Pairs well with Gion if energy holds; otherwise save for Day 6 morning.

title: Fushimi Inari — full summit hike (early)
notes: GO EARLY (6–7am) for empty torii. Full summit hike ~2 hrs through quiet forest — most tourists turn back at the first viewpoint, do the whole thing. June = off-peak, lighter crowds.

title: Arashiyama — bamboo forest + bikes
notes: Rent bikes. Bamboo grove, river, monkey park, Tenryu-ji temple. Allow a half day.

title: Nara Park & Todai-ji
notes: 1,000+ wild deer. Buy shika senbei (deer crackers) for the experience. Todai-ji's giant bronze Buddha is a must.

title: Train to Kasagi (JR Kansai Line)
notes: ~5 min walk from Kasagi Station to the campground.

title: Camp Night 2 — Kasagi Campground
notes: 30,000 sqm along Kizu River. No reservation needed, ~¥1,000/person. Stargazing, river views, Mt. Kasagi hiking nearby. BYO gear.

title: Camp Night 3 — Spring Hiyoshi (Option A)
notes: Option A — rugged. Hot springs, canoeing, fishing. Tent/gear rental on site, English staff. ~$25–40/person. 25 min walk from JR Hiyoshi Station.

title: Camp Night 3 — GRAX Rurikei (Option B)
notes: Option B — glamping. Everything provided (tents, utensils, food, on-site onsen). ~1 hr 15 min from Kyoto. ~$65–120/person. PICK ONE: this OR Spring Hiyoshi.

title: Train Kyoto → Osaka (~15 min)
notes: Quick hop. Drop bags at Osaka stay before sightseeing.

title: Osaka Castle (afternoon)
notes: Huge surrounding park. Museum inside has city views from the top floor.

title: Dotonbori — food crawl (evening)
notes: Takoyaki, okonomiyaki, kushikatsu. Glico Man neon sign photo. Kuidaore — eat until you drop.

title: Minoh Falls (Option A — nature)
notes: 30 min north of central Osaka. 2.7km paved trail through forested gorge to a 33m waterfall. Try maple leaf tempura along the path.

title: Universal Studios Japan (Option B — theme park)
notes: Super Nintendo World. Buy Express Pass tickets in advance to skip the brutal queues. PICK ONE: this OR Minoh Falls.

title: Shinkansen Osaka → Tokyo
notes: ~2.5 hrs, ~$130. Book a window seat on the right side (D) for Mt. Fuji views going east.

title: Shibuya Sky — sunset
notes: Open-air 47F observation deck. Book a sunset slot in advance — it sells out.

title: Optional: DisneySea / Nakano Broadway / Shimokitazawa
notes: Pick whichever you didn't catch earlier. DisneySea is a full day; Nakano Broadway = retro anime/manga shopping arcade; Shimokitazawa = vintage clothes + indie cafés.

title: Farewell ramen crawl
notes: Pick 2–3 spots in different styles (tonkotsu, shoyu, tsukemen). Make it count.

title: Don Quijote souvenir run
notes: Last-minute snacks, KitKats, weird Japanese gadgets. Tax-free counter if you're spending >¥5,000.

title: Head to airport — fly home
notes: Narita Express or Limousine Bus. Allow 3 hrs before international departure.
